response.sql: WITH country_tallies AS (SELECT p.birth_country, COUNT(*) AS attendance_tally FROM player_college AS pc JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = pc.player_id GROUP BY p.birth_country), country_stats AS (SELECT attendance_tally, attendance_tally * 1.0 / SUM(attendance_tally) OVER () AS share, AVG(attendance_tally) OVER () AS average_tally FROM country_tallies) SELECT SUM(attendance_tally) AS combined_tally, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(attendance_tally - average_tally) AS average_above_tally FROM country_stats WHERE attendance_tally > average_tally
